estimator_validation.note: estimate_over_actual >= 1 means the estimator is an upper bound for that prompt (llama3.1:8b tokenizer). Token counts are net of a ~nonce baseline (+/-2 tokens).

summary.note: Read-only audit. No published number, fixture, result or README figure was changed.
summary.default_num_ctx_observed: 4096 (ollama ps CONTEXT column, Ollama 0.40.3, llama3.1:8b, no num_ctx sent), 2026-10-16 on the audit machine; earlier runs may have had a different default (not verified).
caveats: Agent model for the exp1 trials was gemma2:9b (not installed locally); counts here are llama3.1:8b, with a gemma3:4b proxy in proxy_gemma3_4b (same two selection prompts exceed, at ~7.0k tokens).

fixer_source rows are an upper bound: scripts used per-tool scoped source (q4-q6, p2a, rw1, rw2) which is far smaller; only generate_q3_descriptions.py passed whole-file source (q3_real_server.py = 2184 tokens, under the limit).
Task text is the longest in the committed TASKS lists, not every exp1 task.
Only examples/*.py servers were enumerated; real third-party servers a user scans via the CLI are outside the committed corpus.
